q80_domains.description: Corrected Q80 quotient H/V domains from Node-9 structural compression layer (1ee3e6ed).

scalar_language_factorization.description: Каждый из 20 source-классов Node-8 должен быть факторизован как декартово произведение независимых сегментных языков. Leaf-5 также факторизуется как произведение двух сегментных языков.
scalar_language_factorization.completeness_requirement: Verifier must independently derive each per-segment language from bound Node-8/Leaf-5 source and prove that the complete source-entry catalog equals the Cartesian product of those languages.

transition_rules.H_step: Increment left_offset. If active_left_scalar_word exhausted, transition to next H-cell quotient path and select next left segment word from language.
transition_rules.V_step: Increment right_offset. If active_right_scalar_word exhausted, transition to next V-cell quotient path and select next right segment word from language.

symbolic_automaton.state_merging: States with identical field values are merged; their multiplicities are summed.
symbolic_automaton.completeness_requirement: Verifier must independently prove bijection between fine H/V lifts and automaton runs.

width_filter_soundness_and_completeness.statement: For every fine lift L: AUTOMATON_ACCEPTS(L) iff FINAL_POST_SHRINK_COMPACT_WIDTH(L) <= 1.

local_diagnostic_provenance.source: Local scalar-width analysis and symbolic automaton prototype on 97a57154, not an admission oracle.

zero_language.definition: Domain for which the width-filtered symbolic automaton has exactly zero accepting runs.

mixed.definition: Domain for which 0 < accepting multiplicity < total domain multiplicity.
requirements: MUST NOT be promoted wholesale to SUCCESS
MUST emit factorized accepted-language representation including: accepted_symbolic_state_graph, accepted_run_multiplicity, post_shrink_interface, compactification_interface, accepted_language_digest

all_accepting.definition: Domain for which accepting multiplicity equals total domain multiplicity.
requirements: MUST emit the same factorized accepted-language representation as mixed domains
MUST NOT be promoted to repository SUCCESS until the separate repository success-witness/classification contract is satisfied

compact_state_memoization_policy.right_congruence_statement: For every prefix1, prefix2 in the accepted language: if prefix1 and prefix2 are equivalent under compactification, then for every valid suffix S, compact(prefix1 + S) == compact(prefix2 + S).
compact_state_memoization_policy.proof_requirement: REQUIRED if compact-state memoization is used

verifier_obligations: N9S-INV-01: exact Q80 artifact binding (SHA256 and semantic digest)
N9S-INV-02: exact Node-8 and Leaf-5 source binding
N9S-INV-03: scalar-language factorization completeness for all 20 source classes
N9S-INV-04: symbolic transition relation completeness (bijection with fine lifts)
N9S-INV-05: independently prove width-filter soundness/completeness, then validate zero-language certificates
N9S-INV-06: factorized accepted-language representation for every mixed or all-accepting domain
N9S-INV-07: compactification is replayed exactly; compact-state memoization is forbidden unless right-congruence is proved
N9S-INV-11: deterministic byte-identical output under ORIGINAL/REVERSED/SEEDED_SHUFFLE
N9S-INV-12: independent replay and digest-repaired tamper rejection
tamper_attack_classes: N9S-T02: substitute Node-8 or Leaf-5 source SHA
N9S-T03: alter derived segment-language catalog, segment assignment, or Cartesian-product receipt
N9S-T05: promote mixed/all-accepting domain to SUCCESS without factorized representation
N9S-T06: emit zero-language certificate for domain with actual accepting runs
N9S-T08: falsify compactification right-congruence or misuse memoization
N9S-T11: make output depend on entry input order
N9S-T12: claim premature admission, root-reached, or next-gate-open

admission_requires: exact-head CI green on a bound Git subject
